description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Vizier of Tumbling Sands has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Ioreth of the Healing House or Vizier of Tumbling Sands
